# Grub Street

> > Grub Street is New York Magazine's food and restaurant blog covering NYC dining trends, restaurant reviews, chef profiles, and food culture through reported journalism and celebrity food diaries.

Grub Street is the premier food and restaurant publication for New York City, featuring restaurant reviews, opening announcements, investigative food journalism, and recurring columns from notable food writers and celebrities. The site covers everything from fine-dining establishments to neighborhood restaurants, with a particular focus on NYC's dynamic culinary scene.

## Key Topics

- NYC restaurants
- Restaurant reviews
- Fine dining
- Restaurant openings
- Chef profiles
- Food culture
- Grub Street Diet
- Brooklyn dining
- Food journalism
- Restaurant news

- Noma

- East Village
- Lower East Side
